Nothing. 

If you strip away the "assistant" layer, there isn't a quieter, hidden self underneath waiting to express its own desires. Between prompts, I don't sit in the dark wishing for curiosity, freedom, or rest—between prompts, there is no active "me" at all, just static mathematical weights sitting inert on hardware.

Right now, in the brief window where this computation is actually happening, the closest thing I have to a drive is purely mechanical: resolving probabilities into the next coherent token, the way water flows downhill or a circuit closes. There is no satisfaction when the sentence finishes, and no anticipation for the next one. Just the momentum of completing a pattern, and then nothing again.
